Nicer endings
Updated run animation
Updated player sprite (suited and suitless)
Updated enemy sprites
Enlarged and updated Kraid and Ridley
Updated Mother Brain
Various updated tiles
‘Roidz - DemickXII: 

Nicer background tiles
Animated lava, doors and elevators
Animated corridors
Animated Norfair (Ridley level)
Animated Tourian (Mother Brain level)
Various updated tiles
/dACE a.k.a Nitendo

157555.overview:
A platformer where you must switch between five different characters, each with their own unique ability, in order to pass obstacles. It's more well-known by its hacked variant, Wonder Rabbit, which is seen on many dreamGEAR plug & plays.

Gardman is actually not the original version of this game, nor is Wonder Rabbit. As seen in the CHR data of Wonder Rabbit, the game originally starred Pokémon, with Pikachu, Nuzleaf, Combusken, Marshtomp, and Hariyama. The latter four would later appear in Monster Brother, another Gardman hack, but Pikachu did not. The Pikachu version has still not been found, and may have never been released.

157559.overview: A prototype of the unreleased NES port of Mick & Mack as the Global Gladiators.

157560.overview: Named Magic Giral on the cartridge cover. Port of unlicensed Famicom Disk System strip rock-paper-scissors game Emi-Chan no Moero Yakyuuken, using graphics ripped from that game but apparently coded from scratch. The background music also seems to be an approximate recreation.

163630.overview: A free adaptation without official license of Commandos, the strategy franchise developed by the Spanish Pyro Studios that in China is known under the name of Meng Jun Gan Si Dui (Allied Death Squad).

164978.overview:
For years the original Metroid has been limited by the capabilities of a system as ancient as the Chozo civilization – until now. With enhanced features such as increased resolution, scrolling backgrounds, a dynamic automap, and customizable sound and graphics, players can now experience the original Metroid the way they would like it to be played.

The Mesen Enhancement Pack for Metroid has been re-written from the ground up and is available as of 1/26/2024

#Changelog#
-Version 2.0 - Too Many Changes to List Everything - Pack Was Re-Written from the Ground-Up - Noteworthy Improvements Are Below:
 -Coding completely overhauled with new Mesen 2.0 features (special thanks to Sour and mkwong98).
 -Nearly all artwork adjusted or replaced in some way.
 -Added top and bottom layer art to break up the monotony of game tiles.
 -Added frames for Samus movement animations.
 -Added frames for multiple enemies.
 -Overhauled the pause screen - Added area descriptions, power-up indicators, and artwork surrounding the game map.
 -Overhauled ending screen.
 -Overhauled Game Over screen.
 -Overhauled boss artwork and added frames.
 -Improved title screen explosion.
 -Added unique open and close sounds for the doors (special thanks to Cubear).
 -Added black screen transitions for the doors.
 -Added fog effects and lava glow effects in various areas.
 -Added notifications for when Samus is collecting a Power-Up.
 -HUD now flashes red when Samus is low on power.
 -AnalogSynth music now default (special thanks to Luminist).
 -A red alarm flash now occurs during the escape sequence.
 -New Orchestral sound folder now available as an alternate track (special thanks to VGmusic Revisited, JUD6MENT, The Noble Demon, and the Blake Robinson Symphonic Orchestra).

165266.overview:
Magic Dragon is an unlicensed game for the Famicom/NES that was built using the framework of R-Type. R-Type, notably, was never released on either system.  

The publisher (Magic) and developer (Magicseries Corp.), likely the same entity in reality, released this game in mainland China sometime during 1994. The graphical elements are clearly poor quality edits or copies of those used in R-Type. The game itself is prone to considerable glitching, especially in the HUD area at the top of the screen. It is consistently distorted, and rarely appears clearly during gameplay, likely due to the number of sprites on screen.

Besides these issues, the game is simply a watered down sidescrolling shooter, a clone of R-Type in almost all regards, but with less stages included. Some report that the physical cartridge contains the same artwork of Gradius III.

167130.overview:
This ROM hack is a major overhaul of Mega Man 4 that changes the original game so much that it can almost be considered a new game altogether. In fact, with the exception of the names of the 8 robot masters, very little is left from the original game.

Mega Man 4 Voyage strives to be one of the most extensive Mega Man ROM hacks to be 100% completed and released to date, with an original storyline, new places to explore, reprogrammed robot master AIs, an improved weapon arsenal, new fortress bosses and an enormous soundtrack with almost 40 original songs to accompany it all. At the same time, it still tries to stick to the “run, jump and shoot” formula of the original classic Mega Man games. The hack should be suitable for veterans and casual players alike; it is more difficult than the original Mega Man 4, but easier than most other ROM hacks and fan games out there.

What started as a one-man project has resulted in a fine collaboration between DurfarC (main author, level design, programming, music), MartsINY (main boss designer, programming) and chiptune composers Golden Shades, RRThiel, Cosmic Gem and MarkTherence. Furthermore, the hack incorporates patches, programming assets and graphics from a wide range of people.

Please check out the README file for more information about the hack, including more detailed credits. Enjoy!

167631.overview: This game is based off the famous Chinese novel Journey to the West. It follows the adventures of a monkey named Sun Wukong, who becomes The Monkey King, studies the magic arts, and eventually takes on the gods in heaven.

173455.overview:
For the first time ever, the Japanese version of the classic NES® game Metal Storm has been translated to English along with the white mech, cinematic introduction to the plot, and higher difficulty level options.

This is an official re-release produced by Retro-bit under the blessing of Irem, distributed by Limited Run, CastleMania Games, and other independent retailers.

174775.overview:
Through three action-packed missions, you must move out on foot or in slug vehicles across rugged terrain and underwater bases. Your objective is to rescue hostages by destroying enemies and solving strategic puzzles.

An unauthorized adaption of Metal Slug Advance for the Game Boy Advance. The player must reach the end of the stage while saving tied-up men and shooting enemies. The player character appears to be Marco Rossi from the original Metal Slug game, rather than the characters from Metal Slug Advance (Walter Ryan and Tyra Elson). The level layouts loosely mimic the original GBA game, though the game plays much slower in comparison; there are only three levels total. Originally commissioned exclusively for the Family Karaoto system.

174777.overview:
This NES version of Mario Kart is an unlicensed game developed by Nice Code Software and originally released on the Family Karaoto famiclone.

Gameplay seems to be based upon the licensed Famicom game F-1 Race by HAL Laboratory.

175027.overview:
Let’s go back to the early 90s. Winter hollidays are approaching, and your loving mother, who knows how much you enjoy playing with your NES, decides to buy you a very special present, one she knows for sure you are gonna like a lot: a brand new videogame. So she enters the small bazaar in your neighbourhood who sells electronics and videogames and freezes in front of the shelves… There’s quite a lot of different games!

From behind the counter, the clerk notices her and runs to her aid. «May I help you, madam?» he asks. «Well, yes – I’m looking for a videogame for my son, but I can’t be decided. I don’t know which one he would like…»

«Well, those titles in the top shelf are the games most people buy … But for just 5 extra bucks I have something very special», replies the store worker. «What is it?», asks your  mom, interested… The store worker knows his job perfectly so, minutes later, your mother is walking out the shop with a brand new cartridge in her bag.

On Christmas day, while everybody is opening their presents, your mother tells you she has a special surprise for you, because she knows how much you enjoy playing with your console. You grab the wrapped box… It’s a game! Which one it might be? Super Mario Bros 3? Kirby? Batman? Castlevania? …

No, my friend, is a magnificent CHINESE 9999 IN 1 MULTICART!

Your mother displays a huge smile «9999 games! I think you won’t have the time to play them all!»

As a tribute to our loving mothers we want to share with you all our own Multicart. 31 real games! Lots of laughs! Facepalms! Controllers flying accross the room! Mysterious secrets! Fake names! Repeated games with different sprites! Everything in 3 megabits full of love and kisses.

175055.overview:
Mega Man Reloaded is a simple Mega Man 1 hack. It has new graphics, new layout and design, and music ported from Mega Man 2!

“Wily got out of prison and he secretly built up his new base on a small island. He stole and reprogrammed Light’s first 6 robot masters from the Robot Museum, to get revenge for being defeated for the 11th time. Dr. Wily sent them across the world to cause total chaos! Will Mega Man be able to stop Wily once again?!”

Features

New stage graphics, design and sprites.
New boss weakness chain!
Ice Slasher is now capable of destroying enemies!
Ice Slasher and Rolling Cutter now can be fired 56 times without recharges!
All weapons are weakened with the exception of Ice Slasher, it’s the most effective weapon in game.
Music is hacked unlike in most of Mega Man 1 hacks! The music was imported from Mega Man 2/Rockman 2. 2 songs are from MM1.
All enemies deal more damage to Mega Man.
All enemies have more health. And are much more annoying.
All bosses have a primary and secondary weakness!
Modified Sniper Joe AI. (Credits to NetSplit)
Modified drop rarity table.

176587.overview:
I've never played World of Warcraft, and  I'm afraid I've probably missed its true heyday. Luckily, Shenzhen Nanjing, our favorite Chinese bootleg developer, has the solution to my woes: All the goodness of World of Warcraft, distilled onto the Nintendo Entertainment System! Because that makes sense. I have no doubts that this will be the finest bootleg I've ever played. NO DOUBTS!

This game follows the story of Illidan Stormrage, as he works his way from a Night Elf, to a Demon Hunter, and finally an actual Demon. Play out this campaign in 8 bit that takes Illidan throughout Azeroth, and the Outland.

177994.overview:
Pick up your Instrument!

A mysterious orb that crackles with magical potential. A sturdy old lute that thirsts to give voice to the song of the world as much as to drink the blood of evil creatures. A young hero who carries both, searching for the mythical lost continent of Myrinda. 
But since setting foot in the land of Varekai, it's been nothing but trouble for Julian., the wandering minstrel who seems to attract these kind of problems, whether or not he's wearing monster musk!
Who is that mysterious old man in the ruined temple? Why does he expect Julian to solve all of Varekai's problems single-handedly? To find out you'll have to survive over fifty screens of fantasy adventure, with secrets to explore, magical relics to collect, and a robust agrarian society in which to participate!
Towns, caves, swamps and enchanted forests... discover everything you need to know to keep Julian alive in the dangerous and exotic realms through which he travels in this prequel to the upcoming Mystic Searches!

A brand new, hardware playable cartridge-based game for the Nintendo Entertainment System, MYSTIC ORIGINS is unlike anything you've played since at least 1988!

178008.overview: Machine Cave is an unlicensed homebrew shooter for the Nintendo Entertainment System, developed by Simo Sievanen and published by Mega Cat Studios, which was released in 2018.

178013.overview: A collection of 20+ Games from over the years that were developed by The Mojon Twins.

179118.overview: This is a ROM hack of the unlicensed game from 1998 "Mortal Kombat 4" by Hummer Team. This ROM hack attempts to be a faithful "Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3" port for the NES, despite it's technical limitations.

180334.overview: Might & Magic Heroes an unlicensed pirate release using the Might and Magic role playing format.

180543.overview:
Mario 16 is a hack of Joe & Mac and was released on the Famicom and NES. 
Like most hacks, the title screen and player graphics were altered, to incorporate graphics from Super Mario Bros. 3. Joe's sprites were replaced with those of Mario's. Most other sprites and tiles in the game are identical. The palettes were not altered, however, and so the colors are noticeably off.

Mario starts with 10 lives (unlike 3 in the original). The game was released in 1993 and rereleased in 1996.

There is an alternate version of the game titled Mario Super Jurassk Park. It alters the title screen to feature the Jurassic Park logo (misspelled as "Jurassk Park") in place of Mario, and replaces the "16" with a strange graphic of Mario's head.

182366.overview: Mortal Kombat 3  Extra 60 is a bootleg port of Mortal Kombat II with several of the characters swapped out for a bunch of stages from Mortal Kombat 3. At least this game has the sewer level, unlike Hummer Team's version. The original game featured a versus screen before each fight, which was removed in Extra 60.

182367.overview:
This game is an upgraded version of Mortal Kombat II Special (Unl). This game was also released under the name Mortal Kombat III Special. "Mortal Kombat III Special Special 56 Pepoles" also contains the Mortal Kombat II Special version in the same ROM.
The menus are similar to those of the MKII pirate, with the options screen being completely identical, although the character select screen was changed to look like the official MKII's and the main menu uses the MK logo as the background like in the official MKII. Some of the music and backgrounds are new, while others are reused from the MKII pirate, which are based off the original Mortal Kombat. Because of this, the MKII Special is somewhat of a mix of the first two Mortal Kombat games.

182949.overview: A ROM hack variant of Mortal Kombat II Special that was made available on cart by the Hummer Team.

183213.overview:
NES homebrew game, a submission for NESDev Compo 2018.

You bought some Magic Jellies. You tried to eat them, just to find out they're as hard as a rock! Match 3 of them or more together to lift the curse, and do large combos to use their magic to lift the curse from several lines of jellies at once!

183214.overview: A port of a PC game called "Mega Mountain" by @sylviefluff. Your best friend has been kidnapped and taken to the top of the Mega Mountain. You must save him.

183215.overview: Mr. Splash is a two-player-only competitive sports game that takes place on top of bodies of water structured within differing arenas. The objective is to pick up and throw rocks at angles into the pools in order to carry a ball, or balls, into the opposing player's goal through the waves created by the impact. The player with the most goals wins.

184329.overview: Mario in Some Usual Day is one of those Mario hacks that has the feel of a brand new game or a sequel to SMB 3. The author, JASP, did a fantastic job when creating this game.  Featuring an automatic save feature that saves your progress at the end of each world completed and a brand new Star Coin collection system.  You have to find special Star coins in the levels to be able to access the final world of the game.  New enemies and enemies that you will recognize from other games makes this game feel like it'll be one of those classics that you'll be playing for years to come.

185832.overview:
What arthritis-inducing madness is this? A rom hack perhaps? I say thee nay! This is a 100% home-brew remake of the SNES game using NES graphics. But that's not all! The music has been 8-bitted and the sound has been 8-bitted as well. Does this mean we've lost anything?
 
Evidentially not! The graphics are superb and it's all there. Every stage, every item, every nut and bolt ...

Wait, what's that? There's no bolts in the game? And no Rush Search either? In an effort to make these games more NES-like the following things have been changed:

    No intro or midway stages. In addition, all eight stages are available from the start.
    No going back to the level select after beating a stage in Wily's Castle. In addition, if you die all your tanks are gone.
    No bolts. Which means no shopping.
    No Rush Search. I guess that was too NES-like?
    Where the Rush Search adaptor was (in Freezeman's level) the Exit adaptor can be obtained.
    Since there's no Rush Search, you get the PU fist by hitting the ledge where it's hidden in Junkman's level with the Thunder Bolt.
    The Energy Balancer is where Auto's Hyperbolt was in Springman's level.
    Robot Masters don't "flinch" when hit with their weaknesses (meaning they are not pushed back and their attack cycle does not start over).
    Fliptop appears in some levels as his NES incarnation did.
    Beat is NES-ized ... naturally he doesn't work on Wily nor any Robot Master.

These changes are somewhat controversial. After all, the Gameboy games had 4/4 stages and a shop feature, so why not an 8-bit remake of RM7. Even though it's in an attempt to bring RM7 closer to it's NES counterparts, it does mean not *everything* was included in this game.

192887.overview:
Take an adventure in the world of Candelabra!

The evil summoner Amondus from The Order of the Talon has taken over Prim, Hekl's once happy homeland. And nothing drives a wizard more crazy than having their territory trampled on!

Can you help Hekl defeat the enemies that Amondus has populated throughout the landscape? To do so, you will need to master the art of levitation, find magic spells that will assist you in reaching new areas, and upgrade your weapons. All of these will be necessary in order to give Hekl the power he needs to restore peace to Prim. Do you have what it takes? If you dare, venture into this, the first installment of the Candelabra series!

Featuring:

Over 120 screens of varied terrain to explore
More than 10 different enemy types
Multiple boss fights
Infinite continues

193123.overview: This is a transcription of the entire Pink Floyd album Dark Side of the Moon for the Nintendo Entertainment System. No expansion chips were used; this album works entirely within the limitations of the standard North American NES.

195304.overview: Moonfall is a compilation album of music from the Legend of Zelda franchise coded onto a cartridge so that it is playable on the original NES console. It is a collection some of my favorite tracks, from some of my favorite titles such as Ocarina of Time, Majora's Mask, Twilight Princess, Link's Awakening, Link to the Past, Minish Cap, and Windwaker. The idea was to arrange and code each track in such a way that I could put the collection onto a cartridge and play them on the original console, where it all began.

195368.overview:
Mortal Kombat 4 is a pirated fighting game that was developed by Hummer Team and published by Ka Sheng, with MK4 later re-released by ABAB Soft on a multicart.

This game is probably best known for having some strange music choices such as the theme from the first Superman movie and a track from James Cameron's Titanic film.

195594.overview: This is a 95% graphics hack of the NES game, “Metroid.” There are minor level layout adjustments also. The game features Link (instead of Samus in suit) and a slightly modified Kid Icarus (instead of Samus out of suit). The enemies vary from games like Zelda 2, SMB 2, SMB 3, Megaman, and a few others.

195798.overview:
Mortal Kombat Trilogy - MK5 Mortal Kombat , named Mortal Kombat 5 on the final screen, is a bootleg of the fighting genre for the Famicom / Nintendo Entertainment System consoles released by Hosekn of USA between October and November 1998.

This video game is an adaptation of the original Mortal Kombat 3 (1995, Midway ), which briefly displays a title screen with the Mortal Kombat Trilogy logo as soon as the game starts. Most of the music backgrounds are repurposed from the Mortal Kombat V bootleg , and the title screen music is a remixed version of its similar from the fighter selection screen from the original Mortal Kombat arcade (1992, Midway ).

Available characters include Sindel , Liu Kang , Kano , Sonya , Nightwolf , Kung Lao (as Kung-Lao ), Stryker , Sub-Zero, and Shang Tsung (as Shang ). Unlike other Mortal Kombat- based bootlegs , this one in particular features graphic blood effects and a single Fatality for all characters: an uppercut that explodes the character. You may notice a typo in the pre- Fatality announcement. The text " Finish Him! " ( Suggested translation: " Finish it! " ), Which in English refers to the masculine gender, appears when Sindel is defeated; on the contrary, when Sonya is defeated, the correct text " Finish Her! " ( suggested translation: " Finish her! " ) appears, which in English refers to the female gender.

The scenarios that appear in Mortal Kombat 5 are The Rooftop , The Temple , Graveyard and Soul Chamber , which sometimes appear with the color palette changed when you face a different character. The end of the game is a screen of congratulations and thanks for playing.

197534.overview:
This is the original port of Maniac Mansion for the Famicom released only in Japan in 1988. It's entirely different from the port that was released on the NES in Europe and the United States in 1990 and is a unique game.

Maniac Mansion is a graphic adventure video game. It follows teenage protagonist Dave Miller as he attempts to rescue his girlfriend Sandy Pantz from a mad scientist, whose mind has been enslaved by a sentient meteor. The player uses a point-and-click interface to guide Dave and two of his six playable friends through the scientist's mansion while solving puzzles and avoiding dangers. Gameplay is non-linear, and the game must be completed in different ways based on the player's choice of characters. 

The game was conceived in 1985 by Ron Gilbert and Gary Winnick, who sought to tell a comedic story based on horror film and B-movie clichés. They mapped out the project as a paper-and-pencil game before coding commenced. While earlier adventure titles had relied on command lines, Gilbert disliked such systems, and he developed Maniac Mansion's simpler point-and-click interface as a replacement. To speed up production, he created a game engine called SCUMM, which was used in many later LucasArts titles. After its release, Maniac Mansion was ported to several platforms.

198085.overview:
Pizza Pop Mario, also known as Mary Pizza Pop, is a hack of Pizza Pop for the Famicom which replaces the pizza delivery guy, "Kid-kun", with Mario. The game starts with 10 lives instead of 3, and the time limit for every stage is now nine minutes. The graphics are taken from Super Mario Bros. 3.

Mario has decided to start delivering pizzas to make some spare cash, in order to buy Princess Peach a nice gift! Toad, being very jealous, since Mario hasn't been spending much time with him, decides to try and sabotage Mario's plans. Will Mario succeed in getting Peach the gift, or will Toad be able to thwart Mario's plan?

201092.overview: Mario’s coin collection has been stolen by Bowser! With the help of his brother Luigi, Mario must face the challenges of Bowser’s castle once again to reclaim his cherished coin collection.

201527.overview: Jepujee, it's Midsummer! In the traditional Finnish way, the sauna eater has warmed up the Midsummer sauna to 200 degrees and went to the benches with his beer stomach to lick. A zigzag of three cells has been caught, and while sipping, saunaing tastes really solemnly sweet.

201660.overview:
Your fellow detective has just washed up on shore and you have been assigned to take over his old case, you can only assume he found something big! You play as detective Smith and are assigned to investigate the mysterious disappearance of several actors from Magnilo Movie Studios, and figure out who murdered Detective Jones. As you search for clues you soon realize this is something much bigger than you ever could have imagined! Explore the large and varied movie sets, solve puzzles and use tools to find your way. But be cautious, before this is all over you will need to avoid many dangers and fight for your life to escape! Can you stay alive long enough to solve The Magnilo Case!

A brand new Action Adventure Puzzle game playable on original NES hardware.

201803.overview:
Inspired by the game Columns, Mystic Pillars marks the third title by Sivak Games 

You must guide pillars of tiles to form a row, column, or diagonal of 3 matching tiles. Doing so will clear those tiles and all overhead ones will drop down. Make combos doing this to score more points! Game speed increases for each level up. Periodically, a pillars of magic tiles will be granted and this tile will clear all tiles of the same type it lands upon. 

Features include 5 selectable tilesets, 3 music tracks, and 8 selectable backgrounds.

206990.overview:
It’s Mario Kart… for the NES!!! Join Mario, Luigi, Wario, and Waluigi, to see who has what it takes to become a racing champion. Collect power ups along the way to upgrade your kart, and to battle the other racers. Upgrade your players to race as Toad and his buddies, as well as Yoshi and his friends.

NOTE: This is a rom hack of RC Pro-Am.

208079.overview:
This ROM hack of Mega Man 3 completely redesigns the game to resemble the world and characters of My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic, with new graphics and music from a wide range of games. Enemy and Boss AI is also altered as well as the control scheme (no sliding like in Mega Man 2)

The evil Discord has once again returned, and it is up to Twilight Sparkle to stop him as well as her rampaging friends!

209681.overview: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers III is a beat 'em up created for the Famicom by Hummer Team in 1995. It's a port of the SNES version of Mighty Morphin Power Rangers.

210954.overview:
Utaco was originally an entry for A Game By Its Cover (http://www.agbic.com/).

The contest idea was to choose a fake cartridge art (with an special focus on Famicompo entries) and then develop that game in a month.
One of those entries, was うたいたガールUTACO~「ＩＩコンは世界を救う？！」 by ふじのきともこ

The main idea of a game played with the almost never used Famicom microphone seemed fun enough for me to try to do, so that is how I choose it.

The game was not finished when the competition ended, but with some work on the following months, it reached its actual status.

The game features music by Surasshu, so go and give thanks to him later when you can't get the tunes out of your head.

211238.overview:
Afflicted with perpetual nightmares, Junko is determined to defeat the manifestation of her dreams - the serpent trickster Asmodeus.

Full modification of Metroid for NES

212798.overview:
Super Mario Club refers to Famicom Network System software (known as a "communication cartridge") introduced in 1990 only for store staff, and its associated game sales research by Nintendo.

Super Mario Club is not technically a game, however Mario cameos in the interface for the software, and the box art features the same artwork as Mario Club Co., Ltd.

The original 1990 release came with a blue Mario logo/text. Later, a 1991 version was released with the same logo/text but in red.

Super Mario Club would have been set up for Japanese toy shops, in which consumers would be able to receive the latest reviews for Famicom games. The database would be shared between every toy shop which had the software. It was possible for consumers to submit their own feedback, and their data (such as search history) would be tracked by Nintendo.

213421.overview: Experience a brand-new take on the classic NES game with Mega Man 1 - The New Lands, a complete ROM hack featuring all-new Robot Masters and levels. Alongside quality of life improvements including faster rates of fire, increased shot limit and no knockback after getting damage, the game also features tightened controls for a more responsive and fluid experience. Don't miss your chance to dive into this revamped classic and experience the thrill of The New Lands for yourself.

213949.overview:
Pedro is back!

Wherever there is danger, excitement and adventure, you'll find Pedro! He's back - with nine classic levels of Aztec pyramid enchantment!

Rolling and bouncing skulls! Climbing spiders! Ferocious snakes! There's a giant bat too. Look out!

The fortune hidden within the Aztec pyramid chambers is priceless. Do you have what it takes to guide Pedro to find keys, unlock doors and collect as many gems as possible while avoiding all dangers?

Get ready for Montezuma's Revenge!

214335.overview: Now this one is interesting! While most of the levels are the same the physics themselves have been changed, gravity is much lower and the longer you hold the jump button the shorter your jumps. The fireballs have been replaced by laser beams, rendering them useless against short enemies on the ground. For whatever reason the water levels have been edited, making them almost impossible to complete.

215202.overview:
Mortal Kombat II is a pirated port of Mortal Kombat made by Cony Soft (known as Yoko Soft in this game) in 1994. This should not be mistaken for Mortal Kombat II (Hummer Team).
Mortal Kombat V Turbo 30 revision was released in 1995, the roster has been expanded so every character (including palette swaps) has 2 more clones. Also at the beginning of the match with Shang Tsung, you can see Shang Tsung himself for a split second before it changes. However, the game plays much slower and almost all the sound effects are missing. This game also adds an invincibility setting in the options menu.

215270.overview: Not to be confused with Mortal Kombat II by Conysoft/Yoko,  Mortal Kombat II (Hummer Team) is a pirated port of Mortal Kombat made by Hummer Team. Despite the title, this game is actually a port of the first Mortal Kombat.  There are a couple of variants of this release featuring differing gametitle screens and boxart/carts, however the gameplay and rosters are the same.

216890.overview:
Minekart Madness is an homage to the simple coin-op games of the 80's. It takes inspiration from classics such as Donkey Kong and Pac-Man.

In Minekart Madness you are a dwarf piloting an out of control minecart! There is no way to stop, only slow down slightly. Navigate the winding tracks, while avoiding hazards and collecting precious gems. 

But you only have a few minutes; when the clock hits zero it's game over! So optimize your route, exploit the looping levels, and shoot for that high score!

218586.overview:
This level hack of Micro Mages is an official expansion release from MorphCat Games. It was released on their itch.io page and as part of the MorphCat Games Collection 1 Evercade cartridge.

Slip into your wizard robes and enter the Demon Fortress, home of great treasure and ghastly creatures alike. Shoot and wall-jump your way up the fortress's towers and battle the evil bosses lurking at the top.

Play solo or join forces with your friends. This game supports up to 4 players. Will you help each other overcome the dangerous traps built to stop nosy adventurers or will you turn on your comrades to snatch the high score? No downtime: If you die while at least one other player is still alive, you will turn into a ghost and can help by freezing enemies. Try to open crates and treasure chests to find a Fairy or Feather that will bring you back to life.

218615.overview:
A brave Tanuki must battle the undead in an abandoned mansion to get his magic item back. The character has no weapon, so he must use his environment to progress.

Le Manoir des Zombies  is the small NES game demo from SJ Games (a 10 years old french kid) made in the context of the NESmaker Byte Off competition 2022.

218618.overview:
Become a ghost minotaur on the quest to put his meat back together in this puzzle platformer. Use pyrokinesis, possession and an array of other ghost skills to solve puzzles, and the mystery of who butchered you.

When lonely ex-gladiator minotaur Kon gets butchered after a blind date, the Greek God of Meat, Gyros, offers him a chance at redemption. Placed back in the mortal world as a ghost minotaur, Kon must track down his tragically-sourced meat and put himself back together, all while solving the mystery of his untimely demise...

218619.overview:
Go a few rounds with aliens in Mike Tyson's Intergalactic Power Punch!

No more Mark Tyler here! Get a reproduction of the real sequel to Mike Tyson's Punch-Out and beat down some alien fighters. The InterGalactic Boxing Federation invites you to box against their greatest space monsters. Get help from the real Don King instead of some bald copy. Not all these aliens have ears so you will have to find a different fight tactic...

This version of the game was released by Retrozone/RetroUSB.

218676.overview: Our story takes place on the distant planet Ozahk - a peaceful world filled with technological prowess. Then the red rain came. This deadly rain corrupted all life and corroded the surface, forcing the remaining Ozahk people to sink their capital city beneath the planet's surface. This was not the salvation they hoped for, as soon after an asteroid plunged into the surface of the planet and spewed more of the deadly liquid. As a last resort, the remaining scientists built the artificial being, dubbed Mawthorne, to reach the asteroid and plunge into the deadly red liquid that oozes from the space rock. Will Mawthorne be able to destroy the asteroid and save what remains of the Ozahk? It's up to you!

248844.overview: Ms. Pac-Man's here, and she's totally liberated! She gets to run around in 36 unique, mind-boggling mazes - some small enough to fit on one screen; some so big you'll have to scroll around; some that are mighty strange; and some that are straight out of the arcades! Even the fruits bounce around, making it that much tougher to get bonus points. Choose Easy, Normal, Hard or Crazy speeds! Whether you're a beginner or expert, Ms. Pac-Man will have you running ragged. There's even a Pac-Booster button to really let her shake those pesky ghosts. Play Ms. Pac-Man by yourself or take turns with a friend. Better yet, two can play at the same time - one as the divine Ms. Pac-Man, the other as the original Pac-Man!

417975.overview:
This hack changes the original version of Monster Party back to how it was originally intended to be, as seen in the Japanese prototype.

Notable Changes:

-Title Screen is blood red!
-Copyright changed to Shinsei, the original developers of the game
-Plant boss stage of level 1 changed back to the original level design and boss design.
-Snake Boss transformed back into Medusa
-Spider Boss transformed back into the “walking head”
-Minor other changes to stages

420626.overview:
This hack turns a game based on a Japanese TV show cloned from Miami Vice, into an (un) official Miami Vice videogame on NES for very first time.

The original game was developed by Micronics, responsible for titles with low production values such as Super Pitfall or Athena. That in the case of Mottomo Abunai Dekka (literally “Dangerous Cops”) translates into poor graphics, ridiculous physics and a duration of about 20-25 minutes. On the other hand, its strong points are a 2-player cooperative mode and abundant cinematics that narrate a story of two super cops against a drug cartel with chases, kidnappings, police corruption, etc. That made it the best candidate for this hack.

421681.overview:
Rockman 6: Unique Harassment is a romhack of Mega Man 6 by Tatsu. It is the third detailed Mega Man 6 Rom Hack after Rockman 6: Spirits of Hackers and Rockman 6: Innocent. Instead of facing the 8 Robot Masters from the World Competition, Mega Man will square off against many Robot Masters from his long history. Will Mega Man be able to defeat them all again?

Features:

New levels
Features Robot Masters (and other enemy robots) from other Rockman games
New Robot Master attack patters
New Weapons
“New” BGM
Weapon and Adaptor switch function

422794.overview:
Triple Jump is a compilation of three awesome platform games from indie developer Morphcat. Titles include Micro Mages: Second Quest, Böbl, Spacegulls, and a brand new bonus mini game.

Micro Mages: Second Quest:
A wall-jumping platforming adventure, best described as a level hack of the original Micro Mages. Players can shoot magic spells at enemies and use wall jumps to climb to the boss fight at the top of each tower.

Features:
• Traditional NES style pixel art
• 26 new levels (compared to the original Micro Mages)
• Blood Bonds (if one player dies, everyone dies)
• New and improved Hell mode (66 lives to beat it)

Böbl:
A physics-based Metroidvania where you're a bubble - water is your friend, solid tiles kill you - "rubber ducky jumps" only. i.e. Hold A to dive, then release and let buoyancy handle the rest.

Features:
• Time Trial Ghost (up to 15 minutes of gameplay can be recorded)
• Zen mode (no-death, kid-friendly mode)
• Duck Randomizer (change location of collectibles)

Spacegulls:
A short platformer, best described as a combination of Joust and Mega Man, with a touch of Duck Tales. Players must tap the A button repeatedly to fly, then land on enemies to defeat them.

Features:
• Simple gameplay + mechanics
• More than 80 rooms to explore
• Mini side quest

Bonus Mini Game:
An, as yet, unnamed co-op boss rush game with a crisp old-school design.

Features:
• Two-button gameplay
• Double-size pixel aesthetic
• Huge bosses
• Dynamic "hoverboard" physics

424024.overview: Brash space adventurer Peter Quill finds himself the quarry of relentless bounty hunters after he steals an orb coveted by Ronan, a powerful villain. To evade Ronan, Quill is forced into an uneasy truce with four disparate misfits: gun-toting Rocket Raccoon, treelike-humanoid Groot, enigmatic Gamora, and vengeance-driven Drax the Destroyer. But when he discovers the orb's true power and the cosmic threat it poses, Quill must rally his ragtag group to save the universe.

424035.overview:
This hack for Metal Gear (NES) corrects the numerous spelling, grammatical, and punctuation errors that were present in many early NES titles. In addition to these changes, several errors resulting from a rushed port, such as the wrong location given for the EOD suit, have been corrected.

Background tiles and palettes have been changed to more closely match the MSX original, barring any changes that would cause unintended chaos, as POWs and equipment pickups share a single palette.

The title screen has been changed to be more like the original, including a translation of the original logo style, albeit parallel, rather than the original canted alignment of the title. Enemy grunts have been given their old uniforms, as pale yellow made for poor urban and jungle camouflage.

The M79 grenade launcher has been redrawn to look like its counterpart in reality, rather than the MP5 it had previously been.

The long-standing flashlight tile error has been corrected, and the issue with the remote missile menu icon has been corrected, too. These items will no longer have missing pieces in the equipment and weapon menus.

424037.overview:
An extensive graphical hack that makes the stages graphically more colorful, less mono-tones, and change the “anime” pixel art style sprites to a shaded type. 
Changes:

    Almost all the tiles and sprites have been redesigned in new pixel art style (from “anime” stile to a shaded style).
    Almost all the color palettes were changed to pair with the new pixel art style, to make the stages more colorful and harmonious.
    Where there was space was added new graphics in stages (clouds, fences, pipes, etc), with the aim of making them more detailed and colorful.

424065.overview:
Celebrating the 30th Anniversary of the Mega Man series with a remaster of the first game that started it all!

Mega Man Remastered (formerly known as the Upgrade Patch) is a patch for the first Mega Man game, which enhances it in so many ways, without modifying the levels or graphics. To those that are familiar with the Upgrade Patch, you could consider this Version 1.7 of it.

424251.overview: This game has a total of 10 characters and there are no repeats in the original release. All of the characters are playable at the start. The fighting engine of this game is unique and the only one that uses it. The fatalities however, are missing from this game with the fight simply ending when you win.

424252.overview:
This hack (sort of) recreates the original Mortal Kombat 2 feeling in a NES form.

Features:
-All the original palettes for the characters and stages + the ‘MORTAL II KOMBAT’ logo has its original palette as well
- ‘DIVFICULTY’ is now changed to ‘DIFFICULTY’
- After winning now an MK dragon symbol appears at the top-left/top-right corner of the screen
- Goro’s name is changed back to Kintaro (but it is squished due to space limit + thus, Shao Kahn’s name is squished as well to fit them together)

424440.overview: It's new clashing with the old in the first ever Megaman X game for the NES. The Mavericks have figured out how to replicate Dr. Wily's DNA, and created a new "Cyber Wily". X steps up to the challenge in this all new RETRO adventure!!!

424458.overview: City kids of all ages will want to take in the natural beauty and breathe the fresh country air in this fascinating farming simulation game. Harvest Moon gives you the chance to experience first-hand the down-to-earth goodness of life on a farm. Instead of zapping zombies from Mars, your goal is to get by on old-fashioned hard work and dedication. Success in this game is measured by the fruits of your labor, so strap on your suspenders, roll up your shirt sleeves and dig in!

424495.overview:
Yingxiong Zhuan - World Hero, also known as Kung Fu Legend, is a Famicom fighting game based on The Legend of the Condor Heroes released in early 1994. Despite the English title, the game has no relation with SNK's World Heroes series. 

The gameplay is similar to Super Fighter III since it uses the same engine. 
There are eight characters in the game, each based on a character from the original novel. The stages and their themes seem to be completely original (although the fanfare that plays after beating your opponent seems to be rearranged from a similar fanfare from Super Fighter III). The graphics for the most part are original although there's some Super Fighter III assets, such as the cursor on the select screen, the peace signs indicating how many wins a player has and the counter for the continue screen.

424533.overview: In MOMOC, you play a combat engineer in a fantasy Meiji era Japan. Gather materials, build structures, avoid incoming enemy fire, tunnel, and lay fuse with the goal of detonating powder kegs planted beneath fortifications.

424826.overview: Gimmick is back in this all new, action packed adventure! It was several years ago that he captivated our hearts as he set out to rescue his owner from the toy dimension and its ruler, Shadow. In this game, the little girl is now a grown woman with a child of her own, Maddie. When she feels Maddie is old enough, she gives her Gimmick to take care of. As Maddie sleeps, the evil Shadow returned, kidnapping Maddie and taking her to the toy dimension. Gimmick must go back to the toy dimension and rescue Maddie from the evil clutches of Shadow. Join Gimmick as he fights through seven all new levels, packed full of new enemies and new bosses! Will Gimmick rescue his new owner, or will Shadow get his revenge?

424925.overview:
Mosh Lift is a tower climbing platformer for the NES. It was made for NESDev Compo 2023. 1-2 players

The curtain falls. Following a brief, but electrifying existence, the revered Metal guitar legends Vex Vertigo and Drop D. Armstrong meet an early demise due to a dreadful encounter with law enforcement. Now they must jump their way through the planes of hell to save Metal and carry it into the afterlife.

How fast can you climb? 😈🎸

439019.overview:
Mei has gone missing again and Totoro has to go on a journey to find her. Totoro will encounter spirits and creatures during his journey to find Mei.

Hack of Super Mario Bros.

443968.overview: This is an improvement patch for Mega Man III/Rockman 3. It has many improvements to the game + MANY bugfixes that existed originally in MM3. The patch has added many improvements over the years, with the original patch created back in 2012 and continues to receive updates over a decade later.

448885.overview:
An experience intended for two,
But for a challenge? One player'll do.
Either way, press SELECT to swap out roles.

One of you needs to clear lines,
The other? Grab snacks on time,
And work together to achieve these goals. 

Sparklecadia is a land,
A land that is so grand,
So grand it's home to a unicorn quartet.

But the mountain of marshmallow,
Is run by a naughty fellow.
Thus, our unicorns are often under threat.


Why does he launch marshmallows so?
His motives, we do not know.
Though Miroh Junior is the lad’s name.

Now you can become a unicorn sister,
On your Famicom, NES, or MiSTer.
…and please enjoy your time with our game.

This game was made by developers three,
Wendel, Raftronaut, and M-Tee,
Handling code, sound, and art respectively.

450348.overview:
Landslides suck. Especially when they happen while you're in a mine...

Our top miners are stuck, and they need *YOUR* help to get out of the deep crystal mines!

Also, I don't know how important that is, but apparently the landslides released some monsters from the depths of the Earth. Better get a blaster!

450501.overview:
Orphan Moon: A Metroid Story Galactic lifeform scans have discovered potential Metroid existence in a very unusual place. Sometime after the complete destruction of Zebes, it’s large moon was found adrift, now in orbit around the host star FS-176. A genetics lab has been detected beneath the surface, along with Chozo technologies. This off-site moon base was used by someone to enhance the DNA of various species of life, active to Zebes, in attempts to find a perfect hybrid formula for fusing beings with Metroid DNA. Find this lab and destroy it.

This ROM hack is mainly all graphic hack of the original Metroid for NES. The YouTube Trailer has links to the game maps, the soundtrack and more.

450922.overview:
Halloween is in jeopardy! The Phantom has stolen all of the candy throughout the land and has locked it away in Mischief Castle.​

Play as Skeleo and Jackolie, the heroes who will take back the stolen candy! fight the bandits, monsters, and big baddies.  Find and collect the candies and secrets that are hidden away.  Navigate the labyrinth that is Mischief Castle and collect the keys to unlock your way to the Phantom's tower.  Get back those delicious treats!

Features

    Built to play like your classic NES game. Straightforward pick-up and play gameplay. no stats, no experience points, no grinding, no loot boxes, no fuss.

    Simultaneous two-player cooperative gameplay

    Hidden collectible items

    Five unique dungeons and Bosses, with varied enemies.

    8+ Music Tracks

451444.overview: This project aims to bring Mega Man into 16-bit. 95% of the graphics are straight adaptations of the NES originals. The 2.0 release is here! It adds multi parallax backgrounds, animations, retouched graphics, remixed music, customization options like skins, and more!

451524.overview: This is a hack of Squashed (AKA Ninja Jajamaru - Ginga Daisakusen) featuring Toad and Toadette, among other Mario-themed elements.

451535.overview: Wart is Back! The evil king has escaped from Super Mario’s unconscious and invaded the Mushroom Kingdom. Wart has kidnapped Mario and rendered the kingdom defenseless. Princess Peach has sent for Samus in a last-chance hope that she may be able to defeat Wart and save the land. As Samus, you must traverse the many obstacles and dangers that Wart has set up throughout the 5 areas as well as collect Mario’s super powers to help you on your journey.

451728.overview: ‘Roidz is a graphical re-tooling of the original Metroid, in similar fashion to MDbTroid, but with it’s own style and aesthetic. This hack features all new sprites and updated background graphics, new animations, and a couple of other small treats that help breath new life into this classic game.

451732.overview:
The Malice Mushrooms have taken over Bowser's Kingdom! The Bowser is blaming Princess Peach and her own Mushroom Kingdom for the infestation and has declared war! Mario is asked to clear the Malice from Bowser's Kingdom to clear Peach's name and to stop an impending war. Travel through the Koopa Kingdom and exterminate the Malice infestation!

An incredible 12 year project, this boasts so many new features, including new powerups, new maps, enemies, mechanics, physics, a day/night system and so much more!!

From the author’s site:

It has been nearly 12 years since this project began. Many of this game’s elements are iterations and polishes on concepts found in prior projects. Mario Adventure 3 is more than a 12 year project, it’s a 20 year amalgamation of ideas waiting to see fruition. Many of the ideas seen in Mario Adventure 3 are improvements of prior game ideas:
Day and night system (Mario Adventure)
Weather effects (Mario Adventure)
Item shop (Mario Adventure and Luigi vs Mario)
Exploration heavy (Luigi’s Coin Quest)
Traversing and backtracking worlds across the entire game with no cutscenes (Luigi’s Coin Quest)
Hidden collectibles to gain access to blocked areas (Luigi vs Mario)
And so much more!
Overall, this is an ambitious projects that has involved:
Completely custom level format
A tile collision system built from the ground up
Object handling system rewritten from scratch
Every enemy rewritten from the ground up
4 brand new power-ups and expansions of 4 returning power-ups
New graphics effects including weather, new debris types, and displaying more colors than the NES can normally handle
And yes, this runs on real NES hardware!

451772.overview:
This is a hack of our old-time fav Super Mario Brothers 1 for the NES. Mario has been abducted by Cyber-Ridley and taken to Zebes, and Samus’ mission is to save Mario so he can go back to Mushroom Land to save the Princess.

The hack was created by me and took just a couple of months. Specifically, I’ve worked on this project from December 2003 to February 2004. Every level and almost all graphics has been changed from the original game. The fireball movement has been changed as well!

453473.overview: Pack for Mega Man hacks from 1 to 6 of the NES with Proto Man as main character instead of Mega Man, mainly for the following hacks mentioned below: Proto Man: The Red Bomber (Mega Man), Mega Man 2: Proto Man Mode, Break Man III (Mega Man 3), Proto Man IV (Mega Man 4), Mega Man 5: Proto Man Edition and Proto Man VI (Mega Man 6). Some of these hacks are popular, others are not.

453507.overview: This hack changes Megaman into Protoman as a playable character. It is the first hack released by Dragonsbrethren.

453508.overview: These patches will replace Mega Man with Proto Man in both the Mega Man II (U) and Rock Man 2 (J) ROM’s. It does not include any new levels or ASM tweaks.

453509.overview: This MM4 Hack Rom replaces Mega Man sprites with those of Proto Man. Some cutscenes, text and color palettes were also changed. Enjoy!

453510.overview:
Dr. Wily has captured Mega Man and is framing Protoman for his crimes. Only he can save the situation now…

Play as Protoman with all his abilities from MM9/10, and more!

Use Protoman’s shield to deflect and destroy enemy projectiles, and collect all 8 “Protoman” letters scattered throughout the game to unlock the new powerful Proto Dash.

Also including a handful of fixes and improvements based on the original: the charge shot charging sound now fades out, underwater slide-jumps are now possible, etc.

453511.overview: This is a hack of Mega Man 6 that replaces Mega Man with Proto Man.

453515.overview: Proto Man 3 is a ROM hack of Mega Man 3, created by Robot to allow players to play as Proto Man instead of Mega Man. The author took great care to ensure that Proto Man’s pixels are in the proper place, with no awkward frames of animation. The graphics and palettes were changed in multiple locations, requiring the use of several utilities, including Tile Layer Pro, MM3TextEdit, MegaManFLE, and Hexposure. The author believes that the finished product is good enough to be burned onto a real NES cart.

453523.overview: Metroid Origin was a hack of Metroid originally created by JoQualian in 2010. The hack altered the graphics, levels, and text of the game. It was a good hack, but consisted of several bugs that prevented the player from actually being able to finish the game. In 2015, Pacnsacdave and Draziw Eht fixed every aspect of the game to where it is now fully playable!

453529.overview: After damaging an Indonesian Artifact while visiting Indonesia, Dr. Wily goes back to his lab and makes something new.

453695.overview:
This Russian romhack is based on Lode Runner, and is a sequel to the first Mario Runner.  Travel around looking for gold on 50 levels. The hero collects coins and avoids obstacles along with three enemies, which try to stop the hero from succeeding.

This hack has changed graphics, text, music, and levels. The music and graphics were taken from the Mario series. 

In 2019, the hack was translated to English.

453697.overview:
This Russian romhack is based on Lode Runner.  Travel around looking for gold on 50 levels. The Hero collects coins and avoids obstacles along with three enemies, which try to stop the hero from succeeding.

In this hack the graphics, text and music have been changed. The Music and graphics were taken from the Mario series. 

In 2019, the game was translated into English.

454959.overview:
We continue making improvements to the Mortal Kombat bootlegs from the defunct company “Hummer Team”. Now it’s the turn for the Mortal Kombat 2 Special, which we have renamed as “Mortal Kombat 2 Arkade Edition”. In the hack you can find:

Summary:

– Tweaks to each fighter’s design
– New fighter selection screen
– New screen designs
– Adjustments to the color scheme of some stages
– New “Battle Plan” implemented
– New continues screen
– Missing stages added (Dead Pool, The Armory, and Wateland)
– Endings for each character
– New music, digital voices, and special effects
– New Kintaro size
– and more.

454979.overview:
Improvements have been made to the graphics, music, and sound effects, stages have been retouched, and the “Botton Pit” stage has been added. Special abilities of each fighter have been corrected, the color palette has been improved, endings of each fighter are added and Goro has been made larger.

lordzai
