456642.overview: This ROM hack allows for 4 players in the NES classic Mario Bros. There is a setting for the number of lives in the menu,, and the sprites have been remade to 8x16.

456836.overview: A mod for Mighty Final Fight that adds a second player for coop mode.

456924.overview:
This mod brings you a fresh, tougher Final Fantasy with greater depth and tactics. There are numerous creative deviations and system overhauls, though care has been taken to ensure the game still feels like FF1.

Along with the game you will find a comprehensive guide and maps valuable to any new adventurer. Think of them as your replacement for the original paper charts which came with the NES cartridge back in the day.

Some Features:

• Archer & Green Mage replace Black Belt & Red Mage
• Better class synergy & balance
• Restored vanilla features, quality of life & customization patches
• The SHIP can dock at any shore
• Dirt roads help protect you from random battles
• Redesigned all useless items & spells
• Spells can be rearranged & forgotten
• Longer character & spell names
• View usable equipment in shops
• Cycle between party status screens w/ D pad
• Edit window colors on the main menu w/ Select & Start+Select
• Secrets

Combat:

• Greater challenge & reward, less grind
• Actors take their turns one-by-one in battle
• Monsters animate when taking their turns
• INT increases healing power + hit chance for spells & items
• Elemental, creature-slaying, ailment & regenerative weapons
• New status conditions: Regen & Reflect
• Poison is stronger and works on monsters
• Smarter (and more) enemy casters
• Regenerative enemies
• Spell icons highlight their element/effect
• All 8 magic elements have properly defined roles

https://manallsmods.net/

457134.overview:
This is a patch for EarthBound Beginnings that replaces the game’s script with the MOTHER 1+2 Fan Translation (details here) and restores the graphics that were changed or censored during localization. Also included are improvements from the fan translation, like:

Expanded text boxes, menus, and names, allowing for more natural and presentable text
The fan translation’s improved font
The “Easy Ring” added to a present in Ninten’s room. This item, when equipped, greatly increases the experience and money you win from enemies while also reducing the amount of random battles.
And improvements specific to the NES version:

The overall text speed has been increased
Some bugs in the original game have been fixed
For the full changelog and instructions on how to use the patch, please check the readme.

457441.overview: This hack increases the player size by 4 times, allowing them to destroy all blocks just by touching them. During a fall, holding down the down key will also allow the player to destroy the block they are riding.

457842.overview: A hack of Mappy which makes all of the graphics resemble one of it’s sequels, Mappy Arrangement. All the characters, objects, and level tiles have been replaced with versions that more closely resembles Mappy Arrangement. Sadly though, playing as Player 2 doesn’t let you play as Mapiko.

457894.overview: In recognition of the 30th anniversary of Mappy by Namco, Makimura Manufacturing has released a patch which converts the sound engine of the original Mappy by taking the old NROM mapper and replacing it with the NAMCOT 106 mapper used in Mappy Kids. The sound in the game is a closer resemblance to its arcade counterpart.

457906.overview: This is a simple rom hack of Super Mario Bros. that adds a SMB2 USA style character select screen featuring Mario, Luigi, Toad and Peach as playable characters. Each with their own unique physics. Peach has the SMB2 USA style float ability. select screen appears when you begin the game and after completing a level as well as a castle. Only minor things have been changed to accommodate for these changes. No levels have been changed.

457954.overview:
In this hack of SMB1, you play as Megaman.

* The fireball properties are changed to portray Megaman’s shooting technique
* The graphics/sprites are from various Megaman games in the NES series
* All 32 levels and bonus rooms were designed in respect of Megaman’s sliding technique

458036.overview: Unreleased version of the Maxi 15 which was advertised via infomercials which starred Hulk Hogan, Koko B Ware, Paul Orndorff and The Honky Tonk Man. While the infomercial promised 30 games in 1 cartridge, the shipped versions were reduced to only 15 games due to production costs. The 30-in-1 version remained lost until it was found in 2025.

458329.overview:
This is a puzzler. A hack which requires tricky jumps, but not totally glitch abusing skills to pass. You have to figure out the sequence of the rooms, rescue the princess and find all 9 floors.

You start with 50 lives! Remember to use A+Start on the title screen if you die. When you beat the game you will be able to choose world with the B button.

HINT: It’s not always good to be big, sometimes you might need to take a hit.

458421.overview: Role-playing game based on the 1999 film, The Mummy.
458421.developer: Fuzhou Waixing Computer Science & Technology Co. Ltd.

458908.overview: Mauri Mursu's Hangover is a new 8-bit homebrew game for the NES in 2022! The game gets its inspiration from adventure game classics, such as StarTropics and Zelda, and mixes in a lot of quirky off-beat humor and quests. If you are a fan of those games, you will love this one!

458918.overview: Help Mr. Maymunshine, a little red Christmas monkey, collect Christmas items on his way to see Santa Claus! Listen to 8-bit holiday classic songs as you jump your way through a snowy town, a shopping mall, the North Pole, and other locations before resting at your snow-covered home in the forest.

459023.overview: This is a hack made by the RSM group in 2025 for the Russian market. The hack replaces the cook with Mario, and all enemies with Super Mario characters. The plot of the hack tells us that Bowser stole the princess and the cake from Mario and he needs to return the princess and the cake. But will Mario be able to get his princess and cake back? Go through 6 exciting stages and find out!!!

459174.overview:
A unique falling object puzzle game!
Stack the blocks firmly without erasing them!

Melting blocks fall from above one after another. Aim for a high score by lining up blocks of the same color to prevent holes in the bottom of the field!

In the competitive mode, you can play against 15 rival characters. Pierce the opponent's blocks with your laser while keeping your defenses up! Play against your friends!

459374.overview:
They came out of the ether to rampage across our cities, oceans, and homes.

The kaiju: giant monsters from beyond our world.

In response, B.O.O.M (Ballistic Operations and Occupation Military) has deployed its prototype Bumper and Ball weapon, an experimental system that promises to end the kaiju threat.

In this war, there are no winners. So B.O.O.M has to make sure that the monsters somehow lose first – and harder. Whatever the cost.

Can you eliminate the kaiju threat and discover a way to stop them for good?

459419.overview: Mawthorne 2 is a metroidvania, platformer adventure game that takes place after the events of the first game - Mawthorne travels to a nearby moon and explores the depths in search of pieces of the destroyed space station Epsilon 3 in order to enhance his own powers and abilities. However, the underground is not all that it seems on the surface, and Mawthorne will be forced to face many strong foes to earn his new abilities! (While story elements may be clearer by having played Mawthorne 1 or other CGT Games beforehand, it is not required to enjoy Mawthorne 2 as a standalone game!)

459472.overview: Mister Scary is a purple monster that has lost his family! Make your way through the creepies and crawlies of a strange land to find them!

459783.overview: Metal Force NES conversion to Mega Man Zero.

459887.overview:
MazezaM Challenge (pronounced “may-zam”) is a simple puzzle game based on MazezaM from Malcolm Tyrrell. MazezaM Challenge features 34 incredible mazes of mind battles.
Explore each maze as you think with an intrepid boy explorer.
Try to beat the minimum moves required to go to the exit in this exiting journey.

460043.overview:
Mummy: Egyptian Puzzle is a retro puzzle game for the NES, created with Retro Puzzle Maker 1.4.4. Step into the bandaged feet of a living mummy on a mysterious quest deep inside the pyramids of ancient Egypt.

Your mission: find all the hidden Ankh crosses scattered throughout the labyrinthine chambers. Push stone blocks, solve ancient traps, and navigate intricate rooms to uncover each sacred relic. 

Your ultimate goal is to reach Anubis, the Egyptian god of mummification, who awaits at the heart of the pyramid to guide you into the realm of the dead.

With 64 levels of varying difficulty, the game will test your logic, patience, and courage. To play, install an NES emulator and prepare for an adventure buried in mystery, danger, and timeless legend.

460096.overview:
Namco's Famicom version of Millipede, developed by original programmer Ed Logg, started development on March 14, 1986...only to end up being scrapped when Atari Games discovered that the rights to Atari's pre-1984 arcade games were owned by the wholly-separate Atari Corporation.

While they briefly considered retooling the game into an original title with an outer space theme, that version appears to never have surfaced (if indeed it started development at all).

This build was manually compiled from source code (not posted online) by The Video Game History Foundation, and was posted online on June 6, 2021. 

This  port of Millipede is completely different from the Hal Laboratory port that was released for the Famicom in 1987, and the NES in 1988.

460610.overview: Mr. Dragon's Short Quest is a short prequel platfromer game where you save your Dragon buddies from a brainwashing alien invasion!

460971.overview:
You play Pirou, a humble aspiring magician who sees his beloved taken away from him on his wedding day by the evil sorcerer Malasombra, who turns everyone at the celebration into frogs.

Pirou will need to collect the pages of a powerful grimoire, which will allow him to acquire new abilities through transmutations, in order to destroy Malasombra, recover his beloved and reverse all the evil he has done to the kingdom.

461076.overview: This is a homebrew game, made for NES and officially released for free via https://m8si.itch.io/zayla. Be sure to check out their original post, so you can get much more details (like a nice instruction manual, for example) and follow updated versions, okay? If you enjoy it, please, consider to follow the author's pages and to support their projects! You can always send donations on itch.io or comment there to let them know their work reached you.

461127.overview:
Take control of John Maverick in his most dangerous mission yet—before the undead plagued his hometown! Set during the Iraq War, this high-stakes prequel follows Maverick’s journey as a Navy SEAL, where he and his team are captured by Saddam Hussein’s forces.

Armed with your light gun and tactical skills, battle through enemy strongholds, rescue your comrades, and uncover hidden secrets in a gripping top-down maze shooter. thats been called "Zelda with guns" by critics, this game challenges you to outgun enemy guards, navigate deadly traps, and take down one of history’s most infamous tyrants.

461181.overview: A half-demake, half-fangame reconstruction of a certain part of Deltarune Chapter 3 for the actual NES!

461810.overview: Players will navigate puzzle-filled spaces, clearing blocks, passing through ceilings, and switching between red and blue platforms to reach the goal. Despite its simple mechanics, the game offers a surprisingly deep puzzle experience.

462613.overview: This is an HD pack for Ms. Pac-Man, exclusively for the Mesen NES emulator. The pack changes the original sprites to match the sprites from the arcade version.

462676.overview: Become a monarch butterfly on its migratory journey. The way will be treacherous and there’s no slowing down! Keep an eye on your hunger meter, and refill it by grabbing the milkweed flowers scattered around. Beware the monarch’s natural enemies, such as wasps and praying mantises. Make it to the end of your migratory path to join your other monarch friends!

464507.overview:
Much like the Revamped Hacks of 2 and 3, this will complete the original Mega Man trilogy! Just in time for the 38th anniversary of the original!

Among the features:

-New weapon behavior with weapons like Hyper Bomb and Rolling Cutter.
-“You Got!” Screen
-Lag significantly reduced
-New graphics and sprites to make them more in line with later Mega Man entries and official art.
-Rebalancing of difficulty
-Removal of the score system

One of the main goals of this hack was to make as polished a hack as possible within the constraints of the original rom.

464549.overview:
Three years ago, a hack of Mega Man 3 called “Mega Man 3 Ultimate” was released by romhacker TheSkipper1995. It was meant to be a relatively simple hack built on top of KujaKiller’s “Mega Man 3 Improvement”, rebalancing some of the game’s level design and difficulty curve. At the time, the hack was considered satisfactory if a bit conservative in its changes to the base game.

Early this year, at the behest of fellow romhacker DangerDoodle, TheSkipper1995 was convinced to continue work on Mega Man 3 Ultimate with some simple graphical updates. Over the next several months, however, with the programming assistance of KujaKiller, DurfarC, and MartsINY, the project grew into something far more substantial than Mega Man 3 Ultimate. This is “Mega Man 3 Revamped!”

Mega Man 3 Revamped’s purpose is to be a highly polished and streamlined version of Mega Man 3 for people who may not have liked the original game due to its rushed, unpolished development.

Changes Include:

* Liberal changes to level design to make more interesting and engaging use of enemies, hazards, and stage gimmicks; most notably longer Dr. Wily stages with over 40 screens of additional, challenging content!
* Improved utility to Hard Knuckle which can be aimed much faster, Needle Cannon which has a much faster auto-fire rate, and Gemini Laser which doubles its speed after ricocheting once!
* Significant added graphical detail to many stages and cutscenes including Top Man, Hard Man, Snake Man, Gemini Man, and Spark Man!
* Additional fixes to several stray bugs that went unnoticed in Mega Man 3 Improvement!
* A restructured story line that keeps Break Man’s secret hidden until the final act!
* Changes to boss hitboxes and a.i. to be both less frustrating and more challenging!

468173.overview: The story begins with Cheril as she walks into a shrine, falls asleep and dreams of a strange voice that commands her to find her daughters. You must use all your skills to traverse strange areas, battle creatures and hopefully solve enough puzzles to find them and complete your quest.

468788.overview: Here is a complete hack for the Rock Man 3 ROM. All the music, levels, and stage graphics have been changed. Also some of the enemies AI has been altered also. Please note that sliding is closer to 4 or 5 specifications now. Also weapons can be changed via using the select button and done backwards by holding down and pressing select.

468889.overview:
Rockman Cross X is a hack for Rockman 5: Blues no Wana (not the overseas version, Mega Man 5) that changes the game into a boss-rush type with very little focus on platforming. All the bosses have been rewritten, giving each one new attacks not seen yet.

This hack is playable up to the second fortress stage, and features a good number of secret weapons and bosses. You may also enter a pure boss-rush where every boss is confronted in a random order by pressing Select on the title screen.

468890.overview:
Mega Man 1 - Limbo Edition is a hack of Mega Man.

    New visual style.
    Modified Boss Battles
    Custom weapons
    Modified musics (Eerie, slower remixes of the originals)
    Damage tables rebalanced
    Modified Magnet Beam
    Modified Level design
    Weakness has been changed

468891.overview: MegaMari is a hack of the JP version of Megaman called Rockman. The hack changes the level design, palette, and graphics. It is a parody of a Megaman-inspired game for PC called MegaMari. Info on the PC game can be found here.

469792.overview:
Metal Arms is a Family BASIC homebrew made by Shinkan Soft. The game is extremely smooth and fast paced. There are 3 layers of background stars moving at different speeds which add a lot of depth. Lots of bosses which are smaller but look more ship-like and at least 3 standard enemy types.

Published in Micom BASIC (マイコン BASIC) 1990/01 magazine as a type-in game.

470494.overview: Play as Mike, his sister Maria, his brother Mitchell, and his girlfriend Rachel as they try to save the dreambunnies and Drowseborough From the evil Rattha And her Gang of Dream Discombobulators

470589.overview:
“Magic Madness” (or Magician) is a 2000 NES adaptation of a Commodore 64 video game, credited to Colosoftwares, 1985. Jean-François de Wergifosse is probably the developer for both the C64 and NES versions.

Little Merlin, the magic land needs you to fight the evil Kholoo.

To achieve this you will need to have the 4 magic books that are at the end of the 4 levels of the magic land.

Use your magic powers to fight the evil creatures that will stand in your way.

The ‘B’ button lets you change spells and the ‘A’ button lets you use the selected spell.

471009.overview:
This is a remake of Megaman 1 - The New Lands, with the purpose to overhaul the original hack and to make it new, better, fun and challenging.

It features:

    -New stages
    -New level design
    -New gimmicks
    -New weapons
    -New boss fights
    -New enemy behaviors
    -New music and sound changes

471011.overview:
This is a complete hack to a previously unfinished version by DragonEye Studios. The abandoned version had some great ideas and lots of potential, so the purpose of this project was to refine the problematic areas and complete the hack so that the player can play all the way to the end and finish the game.

List of features, additions and changes:

    1) Increased the speed of Mega Man and the Mega Buster!
    2) Wily-4 and other previously unfinished stages are now 100% complete!
    3) Added new challenges to all of the stages!
    4) Changed the entire soundtrack with great music by Blast Hornet, WINED, Tsukikuro, Hydrawisk, DARS, and 8-bit fan.
    5) Changed various weapons mechanics and physics.
    6) Changed boss AIs, HP, and boss room layouts for new challenges.
    7) Changed damage amount from various weapons to different bosses.
    8) Updated various sound effects and graphics.
    9) Increased climbing speed.
    10) Fixed and refined stages from enemy spams and poor layouts from the original version.
    11) Lots of new additional changes to all of the stages.
    12) Updated title screen, menu screens, texts, and ending credits.
    13) Reduced amount of energy used for most weapons.
    14) Various bug fixes.
    15) And many more various additions and fixes.

471013.overview: A bizarre bootleg simulation of Windows 98.

471014.overview: This is a progressive Mini kaizo hack with the “mini” representing level length. It starts off soft with some basics and progressively get harder. 7 worlds 47 levels and quick retries.

477398.overview: A fan made hack that overhauls the entire game with new bosses and improved graphics.

477530.overview:
This is a pirate multicart released by NTDEC in 1991. The cartridge label reads "Media Games 250 in 1", but it's sometimes referred to as Powerful 250-in-1, because that's written on the menu screen, or Golden 250-in-1, because of the label's gold color.

The menu screen features an 8-bit portrait of Arnold Schwarzenegger.

The multicart contains 99 unique games. The other 151 games are trainer hacks of those 99 games. 

Due to the large number of unique games on the multicart, and the fact that it's a fairly good selection of early NES games, this is considered one of the best pirate multicarts of its era, and it's become a holy grail of pirate multicart collectors.

478248.overview: A pirate port of the gameboy game Final Fantasy Legend III. Nanjing later rereleased the game with a title screen hack as Mo Jie Ba Zhu.

479213.overview:
Mickey Mousecapade is built around two characters, but it only ever had room for one player. Minnie trails Mickey under CPU control - snagging on scenery, wandering into enemies, getting carried off by the owl - while the second controller sits there doing nothing. This hack hands her to a second player. Choose TWO PLAYER on the title screen and Minnie answers to controller 2: her own walking, jumping, item pickups, and her own star shots once the upgrades are collected. Both players are live at the same time - no alternating, no turn-taking, no leash. Suddenly the game’s whole premise works the way it always looked like it should. ONE PLAYER is left alone. Every change is gated on the mode you select, so picking ONE PLAYER gives you the original game - the same follow AI, the same owl, the same everything.

* Simultaneous two-player co-op; Minnie is fully player-controlled 
* Title-screen mode select, with a star cursor and menu sound effects 
* Faithful one-player mode: all changes are mode-gated 
* Each character shoots with their own B button in two-player 
* Exactly one background tile differs from the original ROM (the cursor star); no other graphics touched Mapper 3 / CNROM, no expansion hardware - runs on real hardware

479469.overview: RPG based on the Chinese television show My Own Swordsman.

479904.overview:
The game's title translates to Metalstorm, but it's completely unreleated to Irem's NES game Metal Storm and the mobile game Metalstorm. The title just seems to be a conincedence.

He Jin Feng Bao is an RPG that has the player fighting in a tank. The game was developed by Nice Code Software, and it uses an original battle system that isn't seen in other Nanjing RPGs.

480179.overview: The Mariana Sequence is an experimental platformer with an adventure-choosing mechanic that makes the game uniquely different each time you play, as every choice you make as a player affects the game’s seed. You take the role of Cal, a subject in the Mariana Sequence Project, and are tasked with using a piece of software, a game that seems simple on the surface. The object of the game is to explore, uncover secrets and hidden paths, until you discover the correct sequence of events to reach the end and uncover the true The Mariana Sequence.

482551.overview: A port of Phantasy Star IV. An updated version of Wai Xing Zhan Shi.

482664.overview:
Mawthorne 1 Reborn is a complete remake of the original Mawthorne game, completely remade from scratch to improve gameplay, packed with new features, smoother gameplay, and bonus content!

Our story takes place on the distant planet Ozahk - a peaceful world filled with technological prowess. Then the red rain came. This deadly rain corrupted all life and corroded the surface, forcing the remaining Ozahk people to sink their capital city beneath the planet's surface. This was not the salvation they hoped for, as soon after an asteroid plunged into the surface of the planet and spewed more of the deadly liquid. As a last resort, the remaining scientists built the artificial being, dubbed Mawthorne, to reach the asteroid and plunge into the deadly red liquid that oozes from the space rock. Will Mawthorne be able to destroy the asteroid and save what remains of the Ozahk? It's up to you!

482966.overview: An unofficial port of Princess Maker 2 originally made by Gainax for MS-DOS and PC-98.

482971.overview: Released by Cony Soft, this is a hack of their unofficial port of Mortal Kombat II that adds additional content. Shang Tsung is added to the roster as well as a duplicate called Yoko. At the beginning of the round, you can see Kano's sprite for a split second until he transforms into another character. Losing a third of his health bar makes him transform into another character. Shang Tsung transforms from Scorpion, to Kano and then to Rayden while Yoko transforms from Sonya, to Sub-Zero and finally to Liu Kang.

482972.overview: Cony Soft released this hack of their unofficial port of Mortal Kombat II. The roster has been expanded so every character (including palette swaps) has 2 more clones. Also at the beginning of the match with Shang Tsung, you can see Shang Tsung himself for a split second before it changes. However, the game plays much slower and almost all the sound effects are missing. This game also adds an invincibility setting in the options menu.
